title: How to Use Google My Business for Your Coffee Shop: A Step-by-Step Guide | Per Diem

facts.fact: Per a third-party source (searchendurance.com) cited by the article, 90% of weekday business calls originate from Google Business Profiles.
facts.quote: 90% of weekday business calls originate from Google Business Profiles

facts.fact: The article says Google verification usually involves receiving a postcard with a code at the business address, though some businesses can verify by phone or email.
facts.quote: This usually involves receiving a postcard with a code to your business address, though some businesses get the option to verify via phone or email.

facts.fact: Users can manage most of their Google Business Profile directly from a regular Google search or the Maps app, without logging into a separate dashboard.
facts.quote: You can now manage most of it directly from a regular Google search or the Maps app, without logging into a separate dashboard.

facts.fact: The article identifies Google My Business as now called Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: What is Google My Business (Now Google Business Profile)?

facts.fact: The article was published on June 19, 2025.
